epics.title: Resolve Postgres Container Port Allocation Failure
epics.jtbd: When the product environment is launched, I want the Docker containers to start without port binding conflicts, so that the application is healthy and available for use or testing.
requirements: R1: The docker-compose configuration for postgres-app must not fail to bind when port 18080 is already allocated on the host.

slices.title: Fix postgres-app port allocation conflict
slices.jtbd: When implementing the port configuration fix for this epic, I want to change or parameterize the bound port, so that the container starts successfully even if 18080 is occupied.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a host environment where port 18080 is already allocated
When docker compose up is executed
Then the postgres-app container maps to an available port successfully
And the application database starts without a network binding error
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero port conflict errors on startup
